subject: Novus Networks pilot - proposed success statement & evaluation plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Shah <ashah@novusnetworks.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@novusnetworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Novus Networks pilot - proposed success statement & evaluation plan

Hi Aditi/Carlos — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposal for the pilot success statement so we can align internal sign-offs on both sides.

Recap (2 min):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Novus search augmentation (reranking + generation fallback) under production-like traffic.
- Primary concerns you flagged: tail latency, per-token cost under sustained load, and quality on domain prompts.

Proposed success criteria (please comment):
1) Latency: p95 < 90 ms and p99 < 200 ms for 16k-context rerank/generate flows under baseline traffic pattern.
2) Throughput: sustained 45 rps (concurrent queries hitting model) with internal autoscaling tolerances; burst to 120 rps for 2 min.
3) Cost: average effective cost <= $0.0009 per token across evaluation window (tokenization consistent with our embed/gen token counter).
4) Quality: top-1 rerank NDCG@10 >= 0.78 vs your labeled set (bench), and generation ROUGE-L >= 0.62 on coaching prompts.
5) Operational: no more than 1 critical availability incident (>5 min downtime) during the 14-day trial; logs/audit access available.

Evaluation plan (high level):
- Duration: 14 days (pilot), with a 3-week prep for test data & endpoint access.
- Datasets: Novus will provide a 5k labeled validation set + a 20k-sample traffic replay (anonymized).
- Redwood deliverables: endpoint, test harness, sample prompts, and a baseline run within 5 business days of data delivery.
- Ownership: Novus: dataset + sign-offs. Redwood: endpoint provisioning, evaluation scripts, and initial run.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm internal owners for QA and SRE (names + emails).
- We lock the start window: earliest pilot start Sep 7 (after your prep).
- Confirm acceptance thresholds above or propose adjustments.

I've attached a draft SOW and sample_prompts.csv to make this concrete. If these targets look reasonable, we can route for fast approval and spin up the trial.

Thanks —
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Aditi Shah <ashah@novusnetworks.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@novusnetworks.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:38:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Novus Networks pilot - proposed success statement & evaluation plan

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick items from our side:

- Latency: p95 < 90 ms is ambitious but reasonable for rerank-only traffic; generating with 16k context will likely push p99 toward 250 ms. Can Redwood provide a model-variant fallback (smaller quantized variant) that we can auto-failover to if p99 > 220 ms?
- Throughput: 45 rps sustained + 120 rps burst sounds good. We'll have a production-mirroring traffic replay to simulate.
- Cost: we need a target expressed both per-token and per-request (we track per-session costs internally). Can you show per-request cost examples in the baseline run?
- Quality: we'll run NDCG on our labeled set but also want a manual review sample for generative responses (10% of outputs) for product-team sign-off.

Owners from Novus:
- Aditi Shah (product lead) — will own quality sign-off.
- Carlos Mendes (SRE) — will own traffic replay and infra coordination.
- Tara Iyer (QA) — will manage label set and human review.

We can confirm a Sep 7 start pending SOW and access. Please cc Monica and Laura on the deployment window so we can coordinate credentials and audit access.

Aditi
Product Lead | Novus Networks

Hi Aditi/Carlos — Laura here (SE). Wanted to put a concrete evaluation checklist so the pilot runs smoothly.

Evaluation harness (what we'll run):
- Ingest your 20k traffic replay into our test runner (anonymized).
- Run three experiment arms: 
  1) Production-config (your current prompt+model spec)
  2) Redwood-optimized (quantization + batching)
  3) Failover (smaller quantized model).
- Metrics we will compute per-request: latency (p50/p95/p99), tokens in/out, compute GPU-ms, effective cost/request, NDCG@k for rerank, ROUGE/BERTR for generation.
- Sampling: automated 10% human-review sample with tags for hallucination, relevance, and verbosity.

Thresholds (suggested, open to edit):
- Latency: p95 < 95 ms (rerank); p99 < 230 ms (generate).
- Throughput: 45 rps sustained; target warmup 10 minutes.
- Cost: example baseline run shows $0.00085/token on our MPT-variants at the quantization profile we expect to use; will publish per-request breakdown in the pilot report.
- Quality: NDCG@10 >= 0.78; manual-review pass rate >= 85% (no major categories failing).

Data & access items we need from Novus before Sep 7 start:
1) Traffic replay file (S3 link or Drive) + short README on anonymization used.
2) Labeled validation set (CSV with query, gold ranking, notes).
3) A list of 3 product QA prompts for generation manual review.

Deliverables by Redwood during pilot:
- Day 1: endpoint + small smoke-run report.
- Day 3: full-run metrics and cost breakdown.
- Day 10: human-review findings + suggested prompt/model tuning.
- End of pilot (Day 14): final pilot report and recommendation (pass/fail + next-step options).

Attaching sample_prompts.csv and an evaluation_readme. Happy to walk your team through the harness next week.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
